discharged: The exact weighted finite-set census is proved from involution, order-three, conjugation, fiber and image hypotheses. Fibers have sizes one, two, three or six. The number of odd-size fibers equals the number of involution-fixed points; the number of size-one fibers plus twice the size-two fibers equals the number of order-three-generator fixed points. The proof uses equal or disjoint three-cycles, a fixed-point bijection and finite disjoint-union cardinality.
